description:
As a follow-up to the Mega Medical Camp organised by Rotary Club of Mumbai Sher-E-Punjab at Vikramgad on 23rd October 2026, patients diagnosed with cataracts during the eye screening were provided free cataract surgeries on 4th November 2026.

The surgeries were facilitated by Rotary Club of Boisar Tarapur Charitable Trust, ensuring that the beneficiaries received the necessary medical intervention at no cost.

This initiative will enable the beneficiaries to regain better vision, improve their mobility and carry out their daily activities, including agricultural work, with greater ease and independence. The project reflects Rotary's continued commitment to accessible healthcare and community well-being.

Outcome: Improved vision, enhanced independence and better quality of life for the beneficiaries.
